({{small|[[Managing Director|MD]] & [[Chief Executive Officer|CEO]]}}) | products = [[Retail banking|Consumer banking]], [[Commercial bank|Corporate banking]], [[Mortgage loan]]s, [[Private banking]], [[Wealth management]], [[Investment banking]] | revenue = {{increase}}{{INRConvert|34500|c}} (2021)[https://www.csb.bank.in/sites/all/themes/csb/annual-report-2020-21/files/full-report.pdf "Balance Sheet 31.03.2021"]. | operating_income = {{increase}} {{INRConvert|613|c}} (2021) | net_income = {{increase}} {{INRConvert|2273|c}} (2017) | assets = {{increase}}{{INRConvert|47836.27|c}} (2025) | equity = | owner = [[Fairfax Financial]] | num_locations = 654 branches | num_locations_year = 2022 -23 | num_employees = 4180 (2022) | ratio = 22% | hq_location = [[Thrissur city]], [[Kerala]], [[India]] | parent = | website = {{URL|https://www.csb.bank.in/}} }} '''CSB Bank Limited''' (erstwhile '''Catholic Syrian Bank Limited'''){{cite web|url=https://khelnow.com/football/i-league-2021-22-shirt-sponsors-every-club|title=I-LEAGUE: Introducing shirt sponsors of every I-league club for 2021–22 season|website=khelnow.com|publisher=Khel Now|date=21 January 2022|access-date=26 February 2022|first=Waseem|last=Zaidi|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220122125039/https://khelnow.com/football/i-league-2021-22-shirt-sponsors-every-club|archive-date=22 January 2022}} is an Indian [[private sector]] bank with its [[headquarters]] at [[Thrissur city]], [[Kerala]], India. The bank has a network of over 862 branches and 832 ATMs across India.https://www.csb.bank.in/about-us{{cite news|title=RBI lets Watsa's Fairfax to buy 51 per cent in Catholic Syrian Bank|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/banking/rbi-lets-watsas-fairfax-to-buy-51-per-cent-in-catholic-syrian-bank/articleshow/56260554.cms|access-date=15 January 2017|work=[[The Economic Times]]|date=30 December 2016}}{{cite news|title=Canadian firm gets RBI nod to acquire Catholic Syrian Bank|url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/states/kerala/2017/jan/01/canadian-firm-gets-rbi-nod-to-acquire-csb-1554932.html|access-date=15 January 2017|work=[[The New Indian Express]]}} ==History== CSB was founded on 26 November 1920,[http://finance.indiamart.com/investment_in_india/catholic_syrian_bank.html Catholic Syrian Bank, Private Sector Banks In India] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070622085102/http://finance.indiamart.com/investment_in_india/catholic_syrian_bank.html |date=22 June 2007 }} and opened for business on 1 January 1921 with an authorized capital of ₹ 5 lakhs and a paid-up capital of ₹ 45,270.{{Cite web |last=Kulkarni |first=Sneha |date=2021-06-13 |title=List of World's Best Banks In India 2021: DBS Tops, Followed By CBS, ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank |url=https://www.goodreturns.in/classroom/list-of-world-s-best-banks-in-india-2021-dbs-tops-followed-by-cbs-icici-bank-hdfc-bank-1212285.html |access-date=2025-06-28 |website=www.goodreturns.in |language=en}} In 1969, it was included in the Second Schedule of the [[Reserve Bank of India]]{{Citation |title=Reserve Bank of India |date=2026-01-19 |work=Wikipedia |url=https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Reserve_Bank_of_India&oldid=1333745065 |access-date=2026-01-20 |language=en}} Act and the Bank became a [[Scheduled Banks (India)|Scheduled Bank]]. The bank achieved Scheduled Bank – A Class, status by 1975. In Dec 2016, RBI allowed [[Fairfax Financial|Fairfax Financial Holdings]] to acquire 51% of the bank and in Feb 2018, Fairfax India (via FIH Mauritius Investments Ltd) acquired 51% of the bank for Rs.1180 Crores. The terms of investment include a mandatory 5-year lock-in period and 15 years to pare the stake in multiple tranches as per RBI's norms.{{Cite news|last=Saha|first=Manojit|date=2019-08-13|title=Fairfax India gets 15 years to lower stake in CSB Bank to 15%|language=en-IN|work=The Hindu|url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/Economy/fairfax-india-gets-15-years-to-lower-stake-in-csb-bank-to-15/article29086474.ece|access-date=2022-01-10|issn=0971-751X}} As of March 2019, the bank had a significant presence in Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Karnataka with a customer base of nearly 1.3 million people and its credit portfolio focused on agriculture, MSMEs, education, and housing. The bank went public on Dec 4, 2019 and the shares are listed in BSE and NSE.{{Cite news|title=CSB Bank IPO review: CSB Bank IPO opens today; here's what you need to know|work=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/ipos/fpos/csb-bank-opens-today-heres-what-you-need-to-know/articleshow/72177400.cms|access-date=2022-01-10}} ==Sponsorship== Kerala based [[I-League]] club [[Gokulam Kerala FC]] is being sponsored by CSB Bank.{{cite web|date=6 January 2021|title=CSB Bank becomes Gokulam Kerala FC's official sponsor|url=https://www.gokulamkeralafc.com/csb-bank-becomes-gokulam-kerala-fcs-official-sponsor/|access-date=2021-05-31|website=Gokulam Kerala FC|language=en-US|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210106131215/https://www.gokulamkeralafc.com/csb-bank-becomes-gokulam-kerala-fcs-official-sponsor/|archive-date=6 January 2021}} == Management == As of 2026, the banks Board of Directors is as followedhttps://www.csb.bank.in/brief-profile-directors * Mr. Biswamohan Mahapatra (Part Time Chairman) * Mr. Pralay Mondal (Managing Director & CEO) * Mr. B.K Divakara (Executive Director) * Mr. Sumit Maheshwari (Non-Executive Director) * Ms. Sheetal Rupesh Sancheti (Non-Executive Director) * Ms. Sharmila Abhay Kare (Independent Director) * Mr. Sudhin Choksey (Independent Director) * Mr. Sharad Kumar Saxena (Independent Director) * Ms. Renu Kohli (Independent Director) * Mr. Deepak Maheshwari (Independent Director) * Mr. D.N Narasimha Raja (Independent Director) == Controversies == In August 2024, CSB Bank was served an order by the Commissioner of Central Tax and Central Excise imposing a penalty of ₹6.89 crore in tax along with application interest. The order related to the alleged wrongful utilization of ineligible CENVAT credit during 2016-17 financial year, with the bank disclosing plans to contest the ruling before the tribunal.https://legal.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/corporate-business/csb-bank-limited-fined-6-cr-for-availing-ineligible-cenvat-credit/112895377 ==See also== {{Portal|Banks}} * [[Banking in India]] * [[List of banks in India]] * [[Reserve Bank of India]] * [[Indian Financial System Code]] * [[List of largest banks]] * [[List of companies of India]] * [[Make in India]] ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[http://www.csb.bank.in/ CSB Bank Official Website] *[https://netbanking.csb.bank.in/ CSB NetBanking] *{{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140424210533/http://www.csb.bank.in/|date=24 April 2014}} {{Thrissur topics}} {{Banking in India}} [[Category:Banks established in 1920]] [[Category:Banks based in Thrissur]] [[Category:Private sector banks in India]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1920]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]
extract: CSB Bank Limited (erstwhile Catholic Syrian Bank Limited) is an Indian private sector bank with its headquarters at Thrissur city, Kerala, India. The bank has a network of over 862 branches and 832 ATMs across India.
